children: Overview
Swiss real estate investor's preliminary H1 adjusted EBITDA rose 25% yr/yr
Vacancy rate in strategic portfolio nearly halved to 3.3%
Company repaid EUR 170 mln in loans, lowering loan-to-value ratio to 45%
Outlook
Peach Property Group confirms 2026 FFO guidance of EUR 17 mln to EUR 19 mln
Company expects like-for-like rental growth in Strategic Portfolio of around 6.0% in 2026
Peach Property Group targets Strategic Portfolio vacancy rate of 3.5% for 2026, 2.8% at year-end
Result Drivers
RENTAL GROWTH - Co said average in-place rent in Strategic Portfolio increased 3.2% yr/yr to EUR 6.68/m², supporting higher rental income
VACANCY REDUCTION - Co said vacancy rate in Strategic Portfolio fell to 3.3% from 6.3% yr/yr, contributing to improved profitability
CAPITAL STRUCTURE SIMPLIFICATION - Co repaid EUR 170 mln in loans, lowering loan-to-value ratio to about 45% and improving maturity profile
